crossref_corpus_cache.note: Used only as a discovery cross-check; new entries were checked individually.

date_policy: Prefer assigned issue year verified against PubMed/IEEE-deposited Crossref metadata. Preserve Early Access status when no issue is assigned. PubMed electronic dates are not necessarily first IEEE Early Access dates.

date_exceptions.reason: PubMed remains at 2021 Early Access; IEEE-deposited Crossref metadata assigns volume 44(9), September 2022, pages 5385–5400.
Crossref still contains a 2022 Early Access record without volume; PubMed and DBLP identify volume 45(5), May 2023, pages 5800–5815.
The 2019 DOI/online appearance precedes the assigned volume 43(2), February 2021.
Verified PubMed Early Access on September 15, 2026; no assigned volume/issue.

deduplication: DOI and normalized title comparison with all 3,607 baseline entries, supplemented by fuzzy title review. No existing preprint needed promotion. All baseline paper lines preserved.
